_comment: Draft values for the Muse Connector Platform form at https://muse.ai/platform.
Field names and local validator reflect a form captured on 2026-09-21; verify the current authenticated form before submission.
Updated 2026-09-25 for the required Muse store OAuth journey and six-tool salon pilot.
REPLACE_ME fields and attestations must be completed accurately; local validation does not establish approval.
useCases:
Find available haircut appointments at my salon this Thursday.
Show the services offered by a participating spa.
Book the time I selected after showing the full details.
Move my Porter appointment to another time with the same service and staff.
Cancel my Porter appointment after showing the current cancellation terms.
Show my upcoming Porter appointments.
limits: Initial pilot: invited US salons and spas using Square Appointments, one location per business, English and USD. Customers connect Porter from the Muse store through Porter account sign-in and OAuth consent; no manual API key or endpoint setup. Merchant Square authorization is separate. Only reviewed, fixed-price services without unsupported card, deposit, prepayment, cancellation or no-show fee obligations qualify. Payment is at the salon. Time-only rescheduling preserves original staff, service and duration; other changes require contacting the salon. Only Porter-created appointments belonging to the connected customer can be managed. No payments, quotes, provider messaging, unrelated appointment history or medical services.
extraNotes:
Porter is one connector across active participating salons and spas, using merchant-authorized Square access. Owners import public website descriptions, review source provenance and missing fields, authorize Square, select a location and eligible services, then activate. The importer respects robots policy and uses bounded public HTML reads without running website scripts. Square supplies authoritative booking data.

Six MCP tools: search_providers, get_availability, create_booking, list_my_bookings, reschedule_booking and cancel_booking. Creating, rescheduling and cancelling require a two-step confirmation with live rechecks. Pending or uncertain upstream results are not reported as confirmed appointments. Business-supplied text is untrusted data.

Production customer OAuth and the actual Muse store connection are implementation/validation gates. This packet is not ready for submission until those gates, deployment, public policies and the remaining factual fields are complete. Sandbox review uses synthetic test resources, with credentials handled through authorization; public documentation contains no secrets. Meta directory approval remains pending.
